title: FilterConditionField: "is empty" / "is not empty" write `$in: [null, '']` / `$nin: [null, '']`, a null list member every objectstack filter face refuses, so related lists and rollups built with them fail
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named producer**, finding class **(a)**: the widget writes a shape the contract refuses.
- `reach:` named producer. `packages/fields/src/widgets/FilterConditionField.tsx` `condToMongo`, at the objectstack pin `f8a9d0fb0596`, lines 240–241:
  - `case 'isEmpty': return { [field]: { $in: [null, ''] } };`
  - `case 'isNotEmpty': return { [field]: { $nin: [null, ''] } };`
- On objectui `main` the same shape is at `:257`–`:258` (`is_empty` / `is_not_empty`). Both operators are offered by default for text, number, date, select and lookup fields.
- Measured on the objectstack side by the objectstack#20116 dev (report on objectstack#20116, PR objectstack#20247, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). ⛔ Not re-run by this seat. The line reading above is this seat's own.

Found by the `os-dev` round on objectstack#20116. Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`, seat post objectstack#6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why it is wrong

- objectstack's 2026-08-31 null-member ruling refuses a `null` member inside a list comparand at the shared comparand-shape face (`assertListComparandShapes`, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400) in every position. So a filter this widget writes for 「is empty」 / 「is not empty」 already fails when any query face evaluates it.
- The widget is bound to three stored filters, per the objectstack reading:
  - `relatedListFilter` and `summaryOperations.filter` (objectstack `packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts:180`, `:236`);
  - `sys_sharing_rule.criteria_json` (`plugin-sharing` `sys-sharing-rule.object.ts:155`).
  
  A related list or rollup authored with these operators therefore fails at evaluation. The sharing-rule evaluation outcome is NOT measured.
- **After objectstack PR #20247** (the save-door parity collector, in review), the metadata save door refuses the same shape. So the Studio save of a field whose `relatedListFilter` or `summaryOperations.filter` carries 「is empty」 answers 422, with the refusal's prescription. The objectstack seat ruled that #20247 does not wait for this fix: the shape already fails every query, and the save door only moves that failure earlier and makes it loud.

## What the fix is (for the dispatch to confirm)

- Emit the shapes the contract accepts. For 「is empty」 that is `$null: true` OR equal to `''`, spelled as the spec's refusal prescription names it (read the message #20247 prints for `$in: [null, '']`). 「Is not empty」 is the complement.
- Read back stored criteria written with the old shapes (a `kvToCondition`-style reader), so existing rules still open in the builder.
- The objectstack pin bump that carries the fix follows the usual pin procedure.

## Dedupe

objectui search `FilterConditionField isEmpty $in null empty string condToMongo null list member refused`: 2 hits, #4023 and #3567 (both closed, about `$icontains`). Neither carries this shape.
